chief_complaint: fleshy, triangular pink growth of tissue extending from inner corner of eye across clear cornea in chronic sun/wind exposed surfer
hpi_details: 44M surfer presenting with fibrovascular triangular fold of bulbar conjunctiva encroaching onto nasal cornea causing astigmatism and irritation managed with lubricating drops and elective surgical excision with conjunctival autografting.
ideas: He thinks spending so many years surfing in the sun, salt water, and wind caused a rough callus to grow over his eyeball.
concerns: He is worried that the growth is a form of skin cancer that will keep spreading across his pupil and leave him unable to surf.
expectations: He hopes to get soothing drops to stop the irritation and find out whether the growth can be safely shaved off.

teaching.one_liner: 44M surfer with chronic sun/wind exposure and a fleshy triangular growth extending from the inner corner of the eye onto the cornea.
red_flags: Growth encroaching on visual axis or causing significant astigmatism warrants surgical referral

must_ask.say: How much time do you spend outdoors, and do you wear sunglasses?
Has this growth affected your vision or caused blurriness?
Does the area feel irritated, red, or gritty?
Has this been growing larger over time?
We can start with lubricating drops and sun protection, and consider surgical removal if it affects your vision.

history.answer: There is a fleshy pink growth spreading from the inside corner of my right eye onto the clear part, and it constantly feels irritated.
I first noticed a tiny bump about a year ago, but over the past few months it has grown noticeably onto the clear center of my eye.
It is only on my right eye; my left eye looks and feels completely normal.
The redness is right on that fleshy wedge at the inner corner and the white part right next to it, not all over the eye.
It does not throb or ache deeply, but it feels like there is a grain of sand or grit stuck under my eyelid.
My vision has become slightly blurry and distorted in that eye over the last couple of months, almost like an astigmatism.
Bright glare or strong sunlight makes it sting a bit, but looking at regular indoor room light does not cause sharp pain.
No, I have not seen any halos or rainbow rings around lights, and I do not have headaches or nausea.
It waters quite a bit when the wind hits it, but there is no thick yellow pus and my eyelids are not glued shut in the morning.
It feels scratchy and irritated, but it is not intensely itchy like an allergic reaction.
No, my eyelids are not swollen, red, or crusty, and I do not feel any tender bumps on them.
No, moving my eyes is totally painless, my eye is not bulging, and I do not have double vision or a fever.
No, I have not had a cold, sore throat, or fever recently, and no one around me has pink eye.
No, I have never worn contact lenses or corrective eyeglasses.
No, I have never had an eye injury, scratched it with anything, or been exposed to harsh chemicals or welding sparks.
I surf four or five mornings every week, so I spend hours exposed to intense sun reflection, ocean wind, and salt spray without sunglasses.
No, I do not have seasonal allergies, hay fever, asthma, or eczema.
My eyes feel dry and gritty after surfing, but I do not work on a computer all day or suffer from dry mouth.
No, I have never had morning back stiffness, swollen joints, mouth sores, or chronic stomach trouble.
No, I have never had shingles or cold sores, and there are no blisters on my forehead or nose.
No, I do not take blood thinners or aspirin, and I have not had any severe coughing spells, vomiting, or heavy lifting.
No, I have never had eye surgery, eye infections, or high eye pressure before.
I figured all the ocean glare, wind, and sand from surfing just built up a tough callus on the corner of my eye.
I'm really worried this might be a cancerous growth that will cover my pupil and keep me off the water for good.
I was hoping you could give me something to calm the redness down and tell me if a surgeon can just scrape it off.
I have always been healthy and do not have any chronic medical conditions like diabetes or high blood pressure.
I have never had any surgeries or stays in the hospital.
I do not take any prescription medications, just occasional over-the-counter lubricating eye drops when the grittiness flares up.
I have no known allergies to medications, foods, or latex.
I have never smoked cigarettes or used vape products.
I might have one or two beers on the weekend with friends, but nothing beyond that.
I work as an outdoor landscape contractor and live with my partner in a house near the coast.
No one in my family has had glaucoma, retinal problems, or premature vision loss.

exam.finding: Blood pressure 120/78 mmHg, pulse 72 beats per minute, respiratory rate 14 breaths per minute, temperature 36.6 degrees Celsius, oxygen saturation 99% on ambient air.
Athletic, well-nourished male sitting comfortably in no acute distress, shielding right eye slightly from overhead light.

Right eye shows a fleshy, wing-shaped, pink fibrovascular fold extending from the nasal bulbar conjunctiva across the limbus onto the nasal cornea with focal vessel engorgement; left bulbar and palpebral conjunctiva are clear and non-injected.

Visual acuity is 20/30 in the right eye and 20/20 in the left eye; pupils are equal, round, and reactive to light, extraocular motility is full without proptosis or pain, upper eyelid eversion reveals no foreign bodies, and fluorescein staining shows no epithelial defects or ulcers.
Sun-exposed skin without rash, ulceration, or vesicular eruptions across the forehead, nose, or periocular region.
